chapter_note: Apart from a brief formulaic incipit, the chapter is compact, systematic cosmological exposition: a three-zone architecture built from nested fivefold sets (Powers of Darkness → sons of the Man → sons of the [Living] Spirit), described as a suspension/structural-dependence mechanism within the cosmic edifice. No NT citation, exhortation, or institutional application appears.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic opening attribution (“Once again… the enlightener speaks…”) marks the redactional/hagiographic wrapper rather than the teaching itself.

paragraphs.core_text: When he built and constructed the worlds, he suspended the zones on their zones, and within another zone also. The first zone is the five powers of Darkness, males and females.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Impersonal, structural description of cosmic construction; introduces a numbered architecture (“first zone”) and a fivefold Dark hierarchy in-system (cosmos→cosmos), characteristic of the older teaching substrate.

paragraphs.core_text: This is why he hung one zone on a zone! He hung the five powers of Darkness on the five shining men, the sons of the Man; because all the enmity is entwined and bound in them.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the mechanical ‘suspension’ model and correlates two fivefold sets entirely within the cosmology (Dark powers ↔ shining men/sons of the Man), with no contemporary/institutional ‘pointing at’.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, within the zone are the five sons of the [Living] Spirit; because the entire edifice is suspended from them, it being [ ... ... he]ard (?) him too, the oth[ers ... ... ] after them.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third fivefold set nested into the same structural scheme (“entire edifice is suspended from them”); despite lacunae, the voice and content remain systematic cosmological architecture.

paragraphs.core_text: And this is the one who came to [ ... ... the fi]rmaments above [ ... ] which is in one zone, is the great [King of Honour] who e[xists ... ] within the [ ... ... ] of the universe.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fragmentary but still internal cosmological geography (firmaments/zones) and a named cosmic office (King of Honour) presented as part of the universe’s structure, not as a citation or ecclesial application.
